findings.quote: This sets zero factorial to zero. The formula includes zero factorial. Remember its defined value is one.
findings.problem: The note does not explain how the listed answer $0$ arises. Substituting $0!=0$ into the displayed formula gives 720/(720 times 0), which is undefined, not zero. It therefore teaches an incorrect connection between the named mistake and this choice.
findings.fix: Explain that having no alternative group can be mistaken for having no possible team; check that selecting all six members still produces one complete team.
